toml:
# Ground-station pass prediction demonstrator (ground segment & operations).
#
# Predicts the visibility passes (AOS / TCA / LOS, maximum elevation, duration) of
# a circular orbit over a ground station above an elevation mask across a window --
# the rise/set scheduler the static look-angle primitives do not provide. AOS/LOS
# crossings are solved by bisection and the culmination by golden-section search;
# total access time is summed.
#
# The orbit is an SGP4 element set on the IAU 2006/2000A Earth-fixed frame (UT1 = UTC
# and no polar motion unless ut1_minus_utc_s, xp_arcsec, yp_arcsec are given); the
# elevations are apparent, with ITU-R P.834-9 refraction and the downlink light time
# (switches `refraction` and `light_time`, both on by default).
# Run:  kshana scenarios/passes.toml
kind = "passes"

altitude_km = 550.0
inclination_deg = 97.6      # sun-synchronous-like
raan_deg = 0.0
arg_lat_deg = 0.0

station_lat_deg = 52.2       # Delft, NL
station_lon_deg = 4.4
station_alt_m = 0.0

# epoch = [year, month, day, hour, minute, second]  (UTC ~ UT1)
epoch = [2024.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]

mask_deg = 10.0
duration_hours = 24.0
step_s = 10.0
